purpose: Compact, hashed provenance of the pre-RosettaBitcoin archive eras. Imports MEASUREMENTS of retired artifacts, never the artifacts themselves. Documents false starts as measured tunnel depths so the cost-velocity narrative is artifact-backed without re-exposing dead-end material to active agents.

authority.note: Per the archive's own authority-and-constraints contract: historical/audit rows may coexist with active evidence but must never define Bitcoin semantics, select behavior, or serve as implementation guidance. This artifact is citation material for provenance claims only.

il_corpus_manifest.description: The retired btcd assertion-IL harvest. Fully specified, internally consistent, never executed against reality: assertions without executors cannot fail, and an unfalsifiable artifact compiles no knowledge. Frozen in archive/002-btcd-il-harvest/il/. Measured here so its depth is citable without the material being re-imported anywhere agents work.

scar_citations.claim: The lead's first crypto backend was a managed-runtime library, chosen expediently by a scout-phase agent; it carried the port through early consensus discovery before failing the native-performance bar.
scar_citations.compiled_constraint: Native libsecp256k1 bindings required for consensus cryptography (successor baseline contract).
scar_citations.premises: Scoped to consensus-path crypto under sync load; managed-runtime crypto remains acceptable for non-consensus tooling.

scar_citations.claim: The lead's first UTXO accounting ran on SQLite, chosen expediently by a scout-phase agent; it carried early sync before failing under high-churn concurrent chainstate load.
scar_citations.compiled_constraint: RocksDB as runtime chainstate truth (successor baseline contract).
scar_citations.premises: Scoped to high-churn concurrent chainstate at scale. SQLite remains correct for single-writer evidence stores — including the successor's own mission-control database — and this scope limit is the canonical example of a premise-scoped fixture.

velocity_summary.description: Tunnel depths, measured. Each era's cost is a commit/database span, not testimony.
